rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_constrained-claude-agentic: image_size=512, pixel_spacing=0.3516, n_angles=128, n_det=1024, det_spacing=0.35754, sod=500.0, sdd=1000.0, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.5, train_n=400, val_n=200, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, seed=42, dataset_kind=breast_ct, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.15, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, rationale=iter-3 EXPLORATORY single knob fd_recon_init_t 0.3->0.15 from iter-2 base. SIX-BOX: (1)PRIOR: init_t axis is MONOTONIC so far: 0.7 (iter-1 rmse0.0428 psnr18.0 ssim0.427) -> 0.3 (iter-2 rmse0.0264 psnr22.2 ssim0.454). Lower init_t preserves the strong 128-view breast FBP; the breast prior at high init_t repaints/darkens (pred mean 0.036 vs truth 0.126). All hr=0 (FBP baseline rmse~0.00521 very strong). (2)FAILURE: even init_t0.3 lets the prior perturb the FBP enough to leave rmse 5x baseline. (3)ONE KNOB: init_t 0.3->0.15 (embed even closer to FBP; steps/DC/eta held). (4)HYPOTHESIS: pushing init_t toward 0 keeps the recon almost at the FBP while the prior only lightly denoises + DC re-anchors, dropping rmse further toward baseline; maps whether the init_t axis reaches hr>0 or asymptotes above the FBP floor. (5)BUDGET: fewer effective steps, fast. (6)Serial.
